summary: Customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based measurement in the tablet press feed frame can follow API concentration changes in a powder blend, with a first pilot comparing reasonable measurement options before production equipment commitment.

facts_stated.text: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend

facts_stated.text: The blend contains an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks tell them whether the blend is on target.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target

facts_stated.text: Laboratory results arrive after the material has moved through the press.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: results arrive after the material has moved through the press

facts_stated.text: They want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes.
